applicable_patterns: Dark navy section backgrounds (#03253D) for calculators/CTAs
Product hover animations with dual-image layering

seo_strategy_notes: Lead with 'custom print on demand' in title tag
Emphasize 'no inventory' and 'free signup' in meta descriptions
Use action-oriented language: 'design and sell', 'start an online store'
Include social proof in meta (ratings, reviews)
Multi-language hreflang tags for international SEO
recommended_implementations: Add profit calculator widget with dark blue background section
Implement product category grid with hover zoom effect (1.15 scale)
Create dual-image product display (static default, lifestyle hover)
Include trust signals with platform ratings
Use teal accent sections for geographic/global messaging
Add 10px rounded corners to all interactive elements
